Note: *The original postcode file is very large so has been reduced using the following code so it can be uploaded to the GitHub repo*

``` r
ons_postcode <- read_csv("ONSPD_May_2023_UK.csv")

ons_postcode <- ons_postcode %>%
 select(pcds, ru11ind, msoa21) %>%
 rename("Postcode" = pcds)

write_csv(ons_postcode, "postcodes.csv")
```

## Bowel Screening data

Persons, 60-74, 2022/23

```{r}
bowelscreening <- read_csv("202223_rawdata/bowelscreening.csv", 
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
names(bowelscreening)<-gsub("\\s","",names(bowelscreening)) #tidy up column names

bowelscreening_GP <- bowelscreening %>% 
  filter(AreaType == "GPs", Timeperiod == "2022/23") %>%
  select(ParentCode:AreaName, 
         Value:UpperCI95.0limit, 
         Count:Denominator) %>%
  rename("NumberScreened" = Count, 
         "NumberEligible" = Denominator, 
         "pct_coverage" = Value,
         OrgCode = AreaCode,
         OrgName = AreaName)
```

## Age distribution

```{r}
# Population age dist source file
PopulationAgeDistribution <- read_csv("202223_rawdata/gp_popdist.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# gp address list
gp_address <- read_csv("202223_rawdata/gp_address.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

#join age distribution with gp address list
PopulationAgeDistribution <- left_join(PopulationAgeDistribution, 
                                       gp_address, 
                                       by = c("ORG_CODE" = "Code")) 

#tidy columns
PopulationAgeDistribution <- PopulationAgeDistribution %>%
  rename(OrgCode = ORG_CODE, 
         OrgName = Name, 
         Age = AGE_GROUP_5, 
         Value = NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS)

#filter down to just gp, gp code, age band and population for age band 
agedist <- PopulationAgeDistribution %>% 
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "GP", SEX != "ALL") %>%
  group_by(OrgName, OrgCode, Age) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(Value)) %>% 
  select(OrgCode, OrgName, Age, value)

#move age band and totals to columns
agedist_spread <- agedist %>% 
  spread(Age, value)

# creating screening-specific age group and total (60-74 for bowel screening)
agedist_spread <- agedist_spread %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(age60_74 = sum(c(`60_64`, `65_69`, `70_74`))) %>%
  rename(total = "ALL")

agedist_spread <- agedist_spread %>% 
  mutate(prop_6074 = age60_74 / total)

#select only necessary columns
gp_prop_age <- agedist_spread %>% 
  select(`OrgName`, `OrgCode`, total, age60_74, prop_6074)

rm(agedist, agedist_spread)
```

## Deprivation data

```{r}
## Deprivation data ----
gp_dep <- read_csv("202223_rawdata/gp_dep.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
names(gp_dep)<-gsub("\\s","",names(gp_dep)) #tidy up column names

gp_dep2 <- gp_dep %>% 
  filter(Area.Type =="GPs", Time.period =="2019")  %>% #filter to GPs and 2019 deprivation
  select(Area.Code, Area.Name, Sex, Age, Time.period, Value, Count, 
         Denominator, Recent.Trend, Time.period.range) %>%
  rename("Value_dep" = Value,
         OrgCode = Area.Code,
         OrgName = Area.Name)
```

### Joining age, deprivation and bowel screening data sets

```{r}
#combine with age distribution
age_dep <- 
  left_join(gp_dep2, gp_prop_age, by = c("OrgCode", "OrgName")) %>% 
  select(OrgCode, OrgName, Value_dep, age60_74, prop_6074, total) 

rm(gp_dep, gp_dep2)
```

```{r}
#join screening info to age and deprivation info
bowelscreen_demog <- 
  left_join(bowelscreening_GP, age_dep, by = c("OrgCode", "OrgName")) %>%
  rename("IMD" = Value_dep, 
         "GPlistsize" = total) %>% 
  select(OrgCode, OrgName, pct_coverage:GPlistsize)

rm(bowelscreening, bowelscreening_GP, age_dep)
```

## Proportion of men, women and total of people aged 60-74

```{r}
#Proportion of males (taken from age distribution source)
male_popdist <- PopulationAgeDistribution %>%
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "GP", SEX == "MALE") %>%
  select(`OrgCode`, `OrgName`, SEX, Age, Value) %>%
  spread(Age, Value) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(M_age60_74 = sum(c(`60_64`, `65_69`, `70_74`))) %>%
  rename(M_total = "ALL") %>%
  select(`OrgCode`, `OrgName`, SEX, M_age60_74, M_total)

#Get proportion of males within the screening age only 
male_popdist <- left_join(male_popdist, gp_prop_age, 
                          by = c("OrgCode", "OrgName")) %>%
  select(OrgCode:M_age60_74, age60_74) %>%
  mutate(Prop_M_6074 = M_age60_74/age60_74)
```

### Join with main dataset

```{r}
#join male info to screening/age/dep dataset
gp_demog_eligible <- left_join(bowelscreen_demog, male_popdist, by = c("OrgCode", "OrgName")) %>%
  rename("age60_74" = age60_74.x) %>%
  select(-age60_74.y)
```

## GP Address info

```{r}
#Add address info 
gp_address <- gp_address %>% 
  rename ("OrgCode" = "Code",
          "OrgName" = Name)
```

### Join with main dataset

```{r}
gp_demog_eligiblelist <- left_join(gp_demog_eligible, gp_address, by = c("OrgCode", "OrgName"))

rm(bowelscreen_demog, gp_demog_eligible, gp_address)
```

## Ethnicity data

```{r}
# Ethnicity data ----
ethnicity_msoa <- read_csv("202223_rawdata/ethnicity_msoa.csv",
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
ethnicity_msoa <- ethnicity_msoa[1:7264, ] #remove end of file rows

# calculate white ethnicity as a proportion of total
ethnicity_msoa_select <- ethnicity_msoa %>%
  rename(
    "msoa21name" = `2021 super output area - middle layer`, 
    "msoa21" = mnemonic, 
    "ethnic_denom" = `Total: All usual residents`,
    "ethnic_whitebrit" = White
  ) %>%
  mutate(ethnic_whitebrit_perc=(ethnic_whitebrit/ethnic_denom)*100) %>%
  select(msoa21name, msoa21, ethnic_denom, ethnic_whitebrit, ethnic_whitebrit_perc)

rm(ethnicity_msoa)
```

### Join with main dataset

```{r}
# Postcode list 
ons_postcode <- read_csv("202223_rawdata/postcodes.csv",
                         show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_all(function(x) gsub(" ", "", x))

#add msoa to data set
dataset_msoa <- left_join(gp_demog_eligiblelist, ons_postcode, by = "Postcode")
#add ethnicity to data set
dataset_all <- left_join(dataset_msoa, ethnicity_msoa_select, by = "msoa21") %>%
  rename("listsize2020" = "GPlistsize") 
```

## PCN and ICB groupings

```{r}
# PCN to ICB lookup table 
PCN_ICB_lookup <- readxl::read_excel("202223_rawdata/PCN sub-ICB lookup.xlsx",
                                     sheet = "PCN Core Partner Details") %>%
  rename(OrgCode = 1,
         OrgName = 2,
         SubICBCode = 3,
         SubICBName = 4,
         PCNCode = `PCN Code`,
         PCNName = `PCN Name`,
         PCN_SubICBCode = 7,
         PCN_SubICBName = 8,
         StartDate = 9,
         EndDate = 10,
         GP_PCN_shareSubICB = 11) %>%
  mutate(ICB = str_split_i(SubICBName, " - ", 1)) #Extract ICB name from sub-ICB name

PCN <- PCN_ICB_lookup %>%
  select(OrgCode, OrgName, ICB, SubICBCode, SubICBName, PCNCode, PCNName, StartDate, EndDate) %>%
  mutate(StartDate = as.Date(StartDate, "%Y%m%d"),
         EndDate = as.Date(EndDate, "%Y%m%d")) %>%
  filter((StartDate < as.Date("2022/04/01", "%Y/%m/%d") & EndDate >= as.Date("2023/05/01", "%Y/%m/%d")) 
         |(StartDate < as.Date("2023/04/01", "%Y/%m/%d") & is.na(EndDate) == TRUE))
```

### Join with main dataset

```{r}
#join onto dataset
dataset_all <- left_join(dataset_all, PCN, by = c("OrgCode")) %>%
  select(-OrgName.y, -StartDate, -EndDate) %>%
  rename(OrgName = OrgName.x) 

rm(PCN_ICB_lookup, PCN)
```

## Output cleaned data

```{r}
#change proportions to whole number %s
dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(prop_6074 = prop_6074 * 100,
         Prop_M_6074 = Prop_M_6074 * 100) %>%
  select(-SEX)

write_csv(dataset_all, "Cleaned dataset.csv")
```
